sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Vertigo, worse, rising or motion; better
open air. Frontal headache, better eating and open air.
Brain feels loose, head tender. Aching in eyes.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Acid risings, ravenous hunger, nausea,
weight and aching in stomach. Inflation and tension of
stomach and abdomen. [Pothos.] Colic, umbilical
region sensitive to touch. Flatulence.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Gentiana quinque flora (in-
intermittent fever; dyspepsia, cholera infantum, weak-
ness) ; Gentiana cruciata (throat symptoms in addition
to similar stomach symptoms; dysphagia; vertigo with
headache ; pressing inward sensation in eyes ; con-
.stricted throat and head and abdomen. Distension, ful-
ness and tightness in abdomen. Hydrast.; Nux.

sections.text:
Dryness of the mouth and fauces (fifth day),’. — Saliva more
consistent than usual (fourth day),’. — Intensely bitter taste in the mouth,
lasting nearly an hour,*. — Earthy taste in the mouth (sixth day),’.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Swelling, fine sticking, and constriction in the throat, mostly
noticed on the posterior portion of the palate,^. — Frequent hawking on
account of mucus, which is difficult to loosen (fourth day),’. — Eawncss in
